verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI explicitly supports non-interactive/headless execution with structured output flags (--output-format json/stream-json) and ships prebuilt GitHub Actions for PR review, issue triage, and on-demand automation, directly enabling CI/automation use cases. Community evidence corroborates real-world scripted use (e.g., automation abuse for large context tasks) though some users report agentic reliability issues (loops, failures) that could affect unattended CI runs.
